quick: Korean night cream prices in India depend on whether the jar is imported or Korean-inspired and made in India. Imported creams usually cost more because of import costs. Compare by price per gram. Mirc Glow Avocado Korean Night Cream costs ₹649 for 25 g, about ₹26 per gram.
facts: Imported jars are often sold in ml; Indian creams usually in grams.
Mirc Glow creams are Korean-inspired and made in India.
Avocado Korean Night Cream 25 g costs ₹649, about ₹26 per gram.
A 25 g jar lasts about 4–6 weeks with a pea-sized amount nightly.
